technical.summary: Oversold bounce signals (stoch/RSI crosses) present but lack confirmation from price structure, moving averages, and momentum; weak ADX and negative CMF suggest distribution rather than accumulation.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 54 days present material risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buying signal from junior members combined with market fear (VIX-like 30 score) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of senior conviction and absent news sentiment limits conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (104.8) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 54 days adds event risk but not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Oversold stochastic/RSI crosses with supertrend bullish signal and contrarian fear-zone opportunity present technical bounce setup near support (279.70), but lack structural confirmation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, negative CMF distribution signal, weak ADX trend confirmation, zero fundamental conviction, severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis), and earnings event risk in 54 days create a high-risk, low-conviction setup despite oversold technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Oversold stochastic/RSI crosses present technical bounce setup at support, but lack structural confirmation from price positioning below all major moving averages and negative CMF distribution signal.
decision.primary_risk: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 104.8) combined with earnings event risk in 54 days and zero fundamental conviction create high probability of failed bounce into further downside.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Existing ACN position plus 5 other IT holdings in 29-position portfolio creates sector concentration risk; skip entry to avoid compounding exposure in unfavourable macro environment.
